title: TRAK: Attributing Model Behavior at Scale

anchors.paraphrase_zh: TRAK 在线性化 checkpoint 上投影输出梯度，以全训练集梯度矩阵的逆重加权和错误概率项形成逐样本 attribution，再跨随机子集模型聚合。

消融覆盖 projection dimension、独立模型数、同轨迹 checkpoint 代理、早期 checkpoint、逆重加权、Q 项、leverage 和最后一层特征替代。

anchors.quote: Still, TRAK is not without limitations: in particular, it re-
anchors.paraphrase_zh: 作者明确限制方法于可微模型和局部线性近似适用的情形；早期 feature learning、优化器路径和集合交互没有被 estimator 完整建模。

formulas: For target z and training subset S-prime, an additive attribution predicts model output as g_tau(z,S-prime;S)=sum_{i in S-prime} tau(z,S)_i.
LDS is the Spearman correlation across random subsets between actual retrained-model outputs f(z;theta-star(S_j)) and additive attribution predictions g_tau(z,S_j;S).
TRAK linearizes an output function at a trained checkpoint, projects its parameter gradient phi(z)=P-transpose grad_theta f(z;theta-star), and stacks training gradients in Phi.

The practical estimator uses phi(z)-transpose (Phi-transpose Phi)^-1 Phi-transpose Q and averages across models; Q contains 1-p_correct and raw gradient similarity omits essential contextual reweighting.
algorithm_steps: Train multiple models on independently sampled data subsets or collect explicitly identified checkpoints.
At each checkpoint, compute output gradients for exact training and target IDs and project them with a recorded random map.
Form the projected training matrix, solve its contextual inverse reweighting, multiply the error-probability Q term, and score target-to-training influence.
Average model-specific estimators and optionally apply a separately tuned soft threshold.
Evaluate counterfactual fidelity by retraining on held random subsets and computing LDS or by a separately specified removal intervention.
variables: training set S, random subset S_j, target z, model output f, and attribution vector tau
projected output-gradient phi, stacked matrix Phi, projection P, dimension k, and ensemble size M
correct-class probability, diagonal Q term, inverse reweighting, leverage term, and threshold lambda
checkpoint epoch, independent training seed, subset identity, and output-function definition
linear datamodeling score LDS, removal effect, runtime, memory, condition number, and solve residual
selection_timing: TRAK is checkpoint local: features are computed after training a model state, and stronger estimators aggregate multiple independently trained states or checkpoint states.
refresh_rule: A changed checkpoint, subset ensemble, target set, projection seed, output function, or gradient scope requires a new attribution artifact; the paper does not define online replay refresh.

budget.unit: projected gradients and trained models or checkpoints used to estimate one target-to-training attribution vector
budget.denominator: all exact training identities scored for a fixed target set and output function
budget.unique_sample_definition: Attribution rows correspond to exact training IDs, but the paper's estimator predicts additive subset effects rather than a replay selection ledger.
budget.repeat_definition: Training examples recur across random training subsets and model ensembles; repeat count is part of estimator construction, not replay dose.
budget.cumulative_exposure_definition: LDS ground-truth models are retrained on 50% subsets, while removal experiments change datasets; neither intervention matches additive replay exposure or optimizer steps.
budget.compute_cost: Main LDS uses 100 random 50% subsets with five models per subset; strongest baselines use up to 300,000 models, while TRAK trades model count for projected-gradient storage and linear solves.

random_baselines: 100 random half-data subsets with five independently trained models per subset for LDS ground truth
penultimate-layer or last-layer features instead of full projected gradients
randomly selected removal subsets in intervention comparisons

counts: 5 independently trained models for each of 100 LDS evaluation subsets
ensembles ranging from 1 to 100 models in TRAK ablations
8 independent models in the FTRACE-TREX removal experiment
seed_count.scope: counterfactual subset ground truth, estimator ensemble size, and fact-removal intervention
seed_count.aggregation: model outputs or attribution estimators are averaged; this reduces seed noise but does not report sign stability or worst future training seed.

checkpoint_selection: TRAK may use final or early checkpoints and tunes projection dimension or sparsity against LDS. These are attribution-study choices rather than an independent Stage1 checkpoint rule; blind holdout and test must not select them.

results.claim: 完整 eNTK 梯度显著优于 penultimate/last-layer 特征，说明廉价梯度范围不能未经校准直接视作充分。
results.value: eNTK LDS is 0.516/0.413/0.589 on CIFAR-2/CIFAR-10/QNLI versus 0.198/0.120/0.195 for penultimate-layer representations.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: Table 6 的三任务逐行差异支持先在小规模候选池校准最后一层与 fuller-gradient，再决定工程近似。

results.claim: 逆重加权和 Q 概率项是 estimator 的实质组成，raw gradient similarity 的 LDS 很低。
results.value: Full practical variant correlation is 0.499; removing Q gives 0.391 and removing reweighting gives 0.056.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 组件消融反驳仅用 loss、梯度模长或简单 cosine 就等同 reducible/causal influence。

results.claim: 更多独立模型提高 LDS，而同轨迹 checkpoint 只能作为近似替代，不能当成独立 seed。
results.value: With 100 total checkpoints on CIFAR-10, LDS rises from 0.329 using 5 independent models to 0.355 using 100; early-model LDS rises from 0.100 at epoch 1 to 0.308 at epoch 25.

anchor.paraphrase_zh: 早期 checkpoint 含有信息但随 epoch 改变；checkpoint aggregation 与独立 initialization 的证据角色必须分开。

results.claim: 语义检索到的显式 proponents 不等于真正改变模型行为的数据。
results.value: Removing TRAK-ranked abstracts decreases target accuracy by 34%, versus 10% for BM25 and 12% for annotated proponents, over 50 queries and eight models.

results.claim: projection dimension 对 LDS 非单调，维度增加到一定程度后反而下降。
results.value: LDS initially rises with k and then declines; the peak shifts with ensemble size M.

ablations: random projection dimension and ensemble size
independent models versus multiple checkpoints from fewer trajectories
inverse reweighting, Q loss term, diagonal curvature R, leverage, and averaging convention
full projected eNTK gradient versus penultimate or last-layer representations
soft-threshold sparsity and subset ensemble construction
negative_results: Projection dimension is non-monotonic and can reduce LDS beyond a task- and ensemble-dependent optimum.
Penultimate/last-layer features substantially underperform full projected gradients.
Raw gradient similarity without contextual inverse reweighting has LDS 0.056 in the reported ablation.
The theoretically motivated diagonal curvature and leverage terms do not improve the practical LDS variant.
Model/subset averaging can hide attribution signs that disagree across initializations.
failure_conditions: The local linearization or empirical NTK does not represent the relevant finite replay update.
Projection, gradient scope, target IDs, sample order, output function, or checkpoint identity is not hash bound.
An ill-conditioned unregularized inverse changes scores without recorded condition and residual diagnostics.
Checkpoint aggregation is mistaken for independent unseen-seed confirmation.
Additive individual scores miss set interactions, redundancy, or opposing FN95 target directions.
limitations: TRAK predicts counterfactual subset-removal behavior, not additive replay utility under matched exposure.
Its effectiveness depends on differentiability and a suitable local linear approximation.
LDS assumes additive subset predictions and is not a safety metric or seed-success probability.
Projection, threshold, output function, training recipe, and model ensemble are empirically tuned.
Main benchmark recipes are short or modified and do not match the Stage1 fixed trajectory.
No experiment targets FN95, a dual-end constraint, R1/R2/current-loss/no-replay arms, or worst unseen seed.
stage1_mechanism_zh: 该文支持把 A 作为当前 checkpoint、目标样本和训练 seed 条件下的方向候选，并要求保存投影、梯度范围、逆重加权、Q 项、数值条件和逐 seed 未聚合分数。它还反驳 raw gradient/cosine 足够以及同轨迹 checkpoints 等同独立 seeds。
stage1_non_inference_zh: TRAK/LDS 不能证明 replay utility：LDS 衡量随机删减子集的可加 counterfactual 相关，删除事实数据也不是固定基础流上的重复曝光。论文没有固定累计 replay、unique/repeat/steps、独立 FN95 目标或 R1/R2/current-loss/no-replay 配对；任何 TRAK 分数都必须由真实 replay intervention 校准。
